summary: 3DNow 2x2 matrix-vector multiply. The two packed singles of the input vector a2 are duplicated into low/high lanes (v4 = {x,x}, v5 = {y,y}), multiplied respectively against the packed-single pairs at a3[0] and a3[2], and summed pairwise into the output a1->m64_u64. a1 is returned.

operations.description: Emit _m_femms() before and after the 3DNow arithmetic to exit the MMX state.
Duplicate the low lane of a2 into both lanes (v4) and the high lane of a2 into both lanes (v5).
Multiply v4 by the packed pair at a3[0] and v5 by the packed pair at a3[2], then add the two products pairwise.
Store the packed-single sum into a1->m64_u64, treating a1 as the destination this object at offset 0.

unresolved: Whether a1 aliases a2 (in-place transform) is not established; both are distinct arguments.

The prelabel cluster_copy notes a structural twin relationship to FloatClamp (004646c0), but the raw source shows a linear 2x2 matrix-vector multiply rather than a clamping operation; cluster affinity is DERIVED and not used as the semantic name.
The two packed-single pairs at a3[0] and a3[2] are read but the surrounding layout of a3 is not evidenced here.
